identity_boundary: Four Project Gutenberg UTF-8 text carriers for Manmatha Nath Dutt's 1891-1894 English prose translation of Valmiki's Ramayana: Volume 1 contains Bala and Ayodhya Kanda; Volume 2 contains Aranya, Kishkindha and Sundara Kanda; Volume 3 contains Yuddha Kanda; Volume 4 contains Uttara Kanda. This is one historical English translation and electronic edition, not every Sanskrit recension, translation, Ramayana work, commentary, or living tradition.
